Hot start versus the data a program is scored on

A trial hands the agent one worked example, drawn from the task's generator, and it explores from there. The program it writes is then scored against the official train and test pairs. These blocks put the two side by side. On ARC-AGI-1 the hot start looks like the official data in 44 of 60 sampled trials; on ConceptARC, in 5 of 60 — and 98% of the agent's own queries stay in the region the hot start put it in.
